# MCP tools

Contract 1.0.0-rc1, 35 tools. `serve --tools <preset|name,...>` (or `CRG_TOOLS`) limits what the server exposes.

| Preset | Tools |
|---|---|
| `agent` | 14: `batch_query_tool`, `build_or_update_graph_tool`, `coverage_report_tool`, `detect_changes_tool`, `get_affected_flows_tool`, `get_docs_section_tool`, `get_impact_radius_tool`, `get_minimal_context_tool`, `get_review_context_tool`, `list_graph_stats_tool`, `orient_tool`, `query_graph_tool`, `semantic_search_nodes_tool`, `traverse_graph_tool` |
| `all` | 35: every tool |

Every response carries the `_graph` receipt (see [READINESS.md](READINESS.md)); errors use `{status: "error", error_code, message}`.
